behaviour.format: Philips I2S stereo 24-bit samples in 32-bit slots
behaviour.resampler: stateful rational FIR L=4 M=15, 64 taps per phase

production_ap_boundary.reason: The pinned Titan production AP consumes 24000 Hz / 180 samples. Feeding the donor 12800 Hz / 96-sample output into it would be a silent rate and semantics violation.
production_ap_boundary.next_required_implementation: A separately specified and independently verified 48000-to-24000 ingress adapter, followed by host differential and identified-Titan AP execution.

titan_route.transfer: DTC block receive with two 7.5 ms application buffers

u11_mating_header.function: 36-position 0.5 mm pitch 3.0 mm mated-height header for a custom breakout PCB

titan_route.physical_access: U11 is a fine-pitch camera connector and is not a wire-soldering point

u18_rejection.ssie: No complete SSIE0 or SSIE1 pin group is exposed on U18
u18_rejection.spi_b: U18 exposes P102/RSPCKB_A, P708/MOSIB_B and SSLB2/SSLB3, but RA8P1 SPI_B slave mode requires SSLB0 as its input; SSLB2 and SSLB3 are outputs
u18_rejection.gpio: P000, P001 and P002 do not provide SSIE or a complete synchronous receive peripheral
